notes: Revision 3 follows the user correction: the rest/observation platform is approximately 500 mm below the top frame. The four solar panels remain in a single transverse row on the end bay, with overhang only at the front (+X framed end); there is no lateral overhang.

The four proxy panel widths are fitted to the 4547 mm frame width with three 40 mm preview gaps: each panel is 2060 x 1106.75 mm in this model. Those are fitted preview envelopes, not measured product dimensions. The front overhang remains a provisional 635 mm. Panels are horizontal because no tilt angle was supplied.

The approximate 500 mm platform drop is modelled relative to the nominal 2700 mm top-frame level: walking surface Z=2200 mm. The ladder lands at this level. Adjacent proxy headers are aligned beneath the 24 mm deck while retaining the drawing’s nominal 2100 mm underside clearance; member sizes are not engineered.
The six float meshes, locations and masses are retained unchanged from revision 2 at the user’s request. Keeping the current shape does not validate it as a measured buoyancy surface.

The upper deck surface thickness and material are provisional. Its added mass is unknown; inclusion in the 70 kg section weight is unconfirmed. People on the upper deck are additional loads, with mass and body centre-of-mass positions to be supplied.

All listed masses are treated as additive: the 150/70/70 kg EXO section weights are assumed to exclude the separately listed floats, batteries, solar panels and electronics. Confirm this to avoid double counting.
Model follows the 2100 + 1425 + 1425 = 4950 mm dimension chain. The separate 4980 mm dimension is retained as an unresolved 30 mm discrepancy; no silent stretch is applied.
Width 4547 mm and deck-to-top-frame height 2700 mm are taken from dimension labels. Other clearances are recorded but cannot all be reconciled from this raster sheet.
Three EXO sections are assumed: the 2100 mm rear deck is assigned 150 kg; the two 1425 mm frame bays are each assigned 70 kg. This mapping needs confirmation.
Six separate 30 kg floats were confirmed by the user. Float cross-section, end shape, position and volume remain visual proxies.
Batteries and electronics are shown in proposed preview positions only. Their actual installed positions, dimensions and individual centres of mass were not supplied.
Tube wall thicknesses, exact member profiles, joints and fasteners are not specified. Beam solids represent visual envelopes, not actual material volumes.
Masses are user-assigned assembly properties, never calculated from these proxy solid volumes.
The host boat, people, payload, propulsion and other unlisted equipment have no confirmed masses and are not included in the 840 kg subtotal.
No waterline, flotation equilibrium, stability, wave response, structural strength or total centre of gravity has been calculated.
